items.summary: Team lcolladotor Journal Club Presentation: "Polygenic enrichment distinguishes disease associations of individual cells in single-cell RNA-seq data"doi: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-022-01167-z Presented By: Manisha BarseDate: Nvember 18, 2026The paper introduces scDRS, a computational method that integrates GWAS and single-cell RNA-seq data to identify disease-associated cells at single-cell resolution. It highlights how disease associations vary within traditionally defined cell types, revealing distinct cell subpopulations and states relevant to complex diseases.#GWAS #scRNAseq #MAGMA #scDRS
